project_overview.description: Username-based real-time communication platform featuring 1-on-1 chats, WebRTC audio/video calls, 24h ephemeral status stories, social feed, cloud drive, message capsule, and QR ID cards.
project_overview.framework: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4
project_overview.audit_scope: Complete Mobile UI Audit & Interface Model across all viewports (320px to 1366px)

320x568.layout_assessment: SEVERE CROWDING. Header navigation tabs (max-w-[280px]) collide with brand logo and right-hand action icons (Search, QR, Bell, Settings, Avatar, Logout). Stacking or overflow causes icons to be pushed offscreen. Bottom nav bar occupies 64px, Header occupies 64px, leaving only 440px for chat content.

360x800.layout_assessment: MODERATE CROWDING. Header right action icons overflow if middle nav tabs are present. Chat message action triggers (Smile, MoreVertical) remain completely invisible because touchscreen does not fire mouse hover.

375x812.layout_assessment: MODERATE CROWDING. Safe area insets (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) partially absorbed by ChatArea composer, but bottom mobile nav bar adds an additional fixed 64px at bottom, reducing chat reading area.

390x844.layout_assessment: FUNCTIONAL WITH BUGS. Primary mobile bugs remain: message actions (Reply/Edit/React) invisible due to group-hover; ConversationList 3-dots invisible due to group-hover; dual navigation bars (Header navTabs + Bottom nav bar).

430x932.layout_assessment: FUNCTIONAL WITH BUGS. Width allows Header icons to fit with less clipping, but hover-gated buttons remain completely invisible.

768x1024.layout_assessment: DUAL PANE TRANSITION. At md breakpoint (768px), sidebar (w-80) and ChatArea render side-by-side. Mobile bottom nav bar disappears (md:hidden). Header nav bar switches to full text labels (hidden md:inline).

1366x768.layout_assessment: DESKTOP MODE. Hover triggers function normally via mouse cursor. Side-by-side layout works smoothly.

confirmed_bugs.title: Message context action icons (Smile reaction & MoreVertical menu) are completely invisible and unusable on mobile touchscreens
confirmed_bugs.affected_devices: All mobile and tablet touch devices (<1024px)
confirmed_bugs.evidence: className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-0.5"
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: The hover trigger relies on CSS ':hover' which does not trigger on mobile touchscreens without active tap selection. Touch users cannot see the reaction button or the options menu (Reply, Edit, Copy, Delete).
confirmed_bugs.impact: Users on mobile cannot react to messages, reply to messages, edit their own messages, copy message text, or delete messages.

confirmed_bugs.title: Conversation list row options menu button (MoreVertical) is invisible on mobile touchscreens
confirmed_bugs.evidence: className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 dark:hover:text-white rounded transition-opacity cursor-pointer"
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: The 3-dots button is hidden behind 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100'. On mobile, group hover never triggers because clicking the row immediately opens the conversation.
confirmed_bugs.impact: Mobile users cannot access the Pin Chat, Mute Notifications, or Archive Chat actions.

confirmed_bugs.title: Dual redundant navigation bars on mobile consuming excessive vertical screen space and causing header icon overflow
confirmed_bugs.evidence: Header.tsx renders navTabs (MessageSquare, Phone, Share2, HardDrive, Bookmark) inside header even on mobile. Simultaneously, App.tsx renders the exact same 5 tabs in a fixed bottom nav bar (<nav className="md:hidden h-16...">).
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: Header navTabs are not hidden on mobile (<md). They take up to 280px of horizontal space in the 64px header, forcing header utility icons (Search, QR, Bell, Settings, Avatar, Logout) to overflow or get compressed.
confirmed_bugs.impact: Header utility icons get clipped or overflow the viewport; screen loses 128px of vertical height to two identical sets of navigation buttons.

confirmed_bugs.title: Mobile bottom navigation bar remains visible while inside an active chat screen
confirmed_bugs.evidence: Bottom nav bar is unconditionally rendered whenever 'user' is truthy and viewport is md:hidden, regardless of whether a conversation is actively open (selectedConversationId != null).
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: App.tsx does not check if an active conversation is open in ChatLayout before showing the bottom navigation bar.
confirmed_bugs.impact: The bottom navigation bar takes up 64px directly below the chat input dock, severely restricting the visible chat message area and conflicting with mobile virtual keyboards.

confirmed_bugs.title: Emoji / Sticker / GIF picker popover horizontal clipping on mobile viewports (<390px)
confirmed_bugs.evidence: StickerGifPicker has fixed width 'w-80' (320px) and 'left-2 sm:left-4'. On a 320px screen, 320px + left-2 (8px) = 328px, causing 8px-16px of horizontal overflow off the right edge.
confirmed_bugs.impact: The close button (X) and right-column stickers/GIFs are partially clipped outside the screen.

confirmed_bugs.title: Notification dropdown width overflow on 320px–360px mobile viewports
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: Fixed 'w-80' (320px). On a 320px screen with right-0, if the bell icon has right margin or padding, the dropdown overflows the left edge of the viewport.
confirmed_bugs.impact: Left side of notifications modal is cut off on ultra-small mobile screens.

potential_bugs.title: SettingsModal horizontal tab bar has no scroll cue on narrow screens
potential_bugs.description: On mobile, 8 tabs are rendered in an overflow-x-auto flex row. Tabs 6, 7, and 8 (Appearance, Language, Blocked) are completely hidden past the screen edge with no arrow or gradient indicator to show they are scrollable.

potential_bugs.title: CallModal in-call dock overlapping mobile navigation bar if not full-screen z-index covered
potential_bugs.description: Dock has 'absolute bottom-6'. While CallModal has z-50, on devices with home indicator bars (iOS safe-area-inset-bottom), dock controls can sit too close to bottom edge without safe-area padding.

potential_bugs.title: VoiceRecorder waveform and timer crowding on 320px viewports
potential_bugs.description: Waveform uses 'hidden sm:flex', which correctly protects mobile space, but timer and stop button can crowd discard button on 320px screens if recording duration exceeds 3 digits.

recommended_fixes.recommendation: Provide mobile-accessible message actions. Either make the action trigger visible on mobile touch devices (e.g. 'opacity-100 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100') or implement a long-press / tap gesture on the message bubble to display the reaction and action sheet on mobile.
Make the 3-dots options menu icon visible on mobile ('opacity-100 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100') or allow swipe / long-press on conversation items to access Pin/Mute/Archive.

Hide the middle navTabs in Header on mobile screens by adding 'hidden md:flex' to the navTabs container, since the Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar already serves this purpose. This immediately frees up ~280px in the header, resolving all clipping and overflow for Search, QR, Bell, Settings, and Profile icons.

Hide the mobile bottom navigation bar when inside an active conversation (e.g. pass an isChatOpen state or hide bottom nav when selectedConversationId is set), maximizing screen real-estate for messaging.
Replace fixed 'w-80' with 'w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] sm:w-96 max-w-sm' to guarantee the picker never exceeds screen width on 320px–360px phones.
Update dropdown width to 'w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:w-96 max-w-sm right-0 sm:right-0' to avoid left clipping on narrow viewports.
